services.name: Mountain Tubing Adventure
services.desc: TUBING! TUNNELS! TONS OF FUN! Adventure Information Approximately 3 hours total tour time Age: 5 yrs. and older welcome What to Bring: Water Friendly Shoes NO FLIP FLOPS (Crocs available for rent) Swimsuit and/or clothing that can get wet Towel & change of dry clothing (optional) Reef-Safe Sunscreen (help us protect our precious ocean!) Hat (optional) Bug Repellent (optional) A bag for your belongings We Provide: Gloves Lunch Headlamps Tubes Food and Drink: We provide a delicious picnic lunch and cold water Restrictions: Must be a minimum of 43 inches tall Weight limit - 300 lbs. 3 Hours · Ages 5+

services.name: Zipline Tour
services.desc: Tour Details Tour Length/Info 3 hours & 7 Ziplines What to Bring: Knee length shorts, leggings, or pants Closed-toe, covered shoes such as tennis shoes or hiking shoes (No water shoes or five finger shoes) Swimsuit and Towel (optional swimming hole) Bug Repellent REEF SAFE Sunscreen (Help us protect our precious Ocean!) Hat (optional) Hair tie to secure long hair We Provide: Helmets Food and Drink: A delicious lunch and cold water included Restrictions: Age: 12 yrs. and older Weight range: 100-250 pounds All guests will weigh-in at check-in. Those outside the 100-250 pounds range 3 Hours · Ages 12+

services.name: Mountain Tubing Adventure Waitlist
services.desc: Please be advised, this is not a purchased booking. When booking, you'll have the option to select a preferred start time. Once an opening occurs, we will contact you to book and confirm a reservation. Preferred tubing dates full? Sign up for our waitlist!

includes: It includes spectacular views of the ocean, coastline, mountains, and valleys.
blurb: Guests tube down an old sugar plantation irrigation system through canals and tunnels. They also can soar on a zipline course along a mountain side to a bamboo grove. The tours include learning about Kaua'i's history, culture, and natural environment.
extraNote: Mountain Tubing Adventure waitlist available if preferred dates are full; waitlist is not a booking · Weather: Unless weather prohibits, tours go out rain or shine. · Women in first trimester of pregnancy may participate with written physician approval Weather: Unless weather prohibits, tours go out rain or shine Please note, because we live on a tropical island, the weather can change very quickly. · We will do our best to give you as much notice as possible if tours are cancelled due to the weather. · Customers will also receive a full refund in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
